name: @tty-pt/lamina
description: Universal Node.js and Browser bindings for liblamina 2D/3D immediate-mode canvas and WebGL graphics engine

scripts.build:native: mkdir -p build/Release && gcc -O3 -fPIC -shared -I/usr/include/node native/lamina_napi.c -lm -o build/Release/lamina_node.node 2>/dev/null || true
scripts.build: npm run build:native && npm run build:wasm

author: Paulo Quirino
